note: Initial cohorts presented with pure limb-girdle muscular dystrophy without prominent CNS malformations, but subsequent studies identified neurodevelopmental defects and cerebellar atrophy in some patients.

evidence.text: Initial report describes five patients from two unrelated families with a limb-girdle muscular dystrophy phenotype presenting with proximal weakness, contractures, and respiratory dysfunction, without reported CNS malformations.

source.title: Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause a limb girdle muscular dystrophy with myofibrillar-like features
source.quote: Here, we present five patients from two unrelated families with a limb-girdle muscular dystrophy (LGMD) phenotype carrying a biallelic variant in SNUPN gene.

evidence.text: Subsequent studies expand the phenotypic spectrum, noting that patients can exhibit neurological and neurodevelopmental defects as well as spinocerebellar ataxia.

source.title: SNUPN deficiency causes a recessive muscular dystrophy due to RNA mis-splicing and ECM dysregulation
source.quote: In this study, we investigate 18 children from 15 unrelated families who present with atypical muscular dystrophy and neurological defects.
